requiredRepair.rule: a convergence effect counts only when a module carrying that declaration actually commits; a loop may require named effects before its raw end predicate is accepted
doNotSolveBy: letting an effect label alone mutate state
replacing hard end invariants with labels

claimBoundary: This evidence shows convergence_effects is currently signed descriptive metadata in v0.10. It does not yet establish the right semantics for arbitrary convergence topologies.
